SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT df."RecordRegistry"
    FROM "DataFlow" df
    JOIN "DataProfile" dp ON df."RecordRegistry" = dp."Flow_Sign"
    JOIN "AuditAndCompliance" ac ON dp."profileTrace" = ac.profjoin
    JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON dp."riskJoin" = rm."RISKTRACE"
    JOIN "Compliance" c ON rm."RISKTRACE" = c."risk_tie"
    WHERE df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' <> df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country'
    AND (
        c."gdprComp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial')
        OR c."CCPA_COMP" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial')
        OR c."PIPLcomp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial')
        OR c."loc_law_comp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial')
        OR ac."critFindNum" > 0
        OR ac."AudtrailState" IN ('Missing', 'Partial')
        OR ac."remed_state" != 'Completed'
    )
) sub;

CREATE VIEW cross_border_compliance_gap_view AS
SELECT 
    df."RecordRegistry" AS flow_registry,
    df.flow_overview->'classification'->>'flow_tag' AS flow_tag,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' AS origin_country,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' AS dest_country,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_actor' AS origin_actor,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_actor' AS dest_actor,
    df.flow_overview->'classification'->>'data_category' AS data_category,
    df.flow_overview->'classification'->>'sensitivity_level' AS sensitivity_level,
    dp."DATATYPE" AS data_type,
    ac."AudtrailState" AS audit_state,
    ac."critFindNum" AS critical_findings,
    ac."FINDTALLY" AS total_findings,
    ac."remed_state" AS remediation_status,
    c."gdprComp" AS gdpr_compliance,
    c."CCPA_COMP" AS ccpa_compliance,
    c."PIPLcomp" AS pipl_compliance,
    c."loc_law_comp" AS local_law_compliance,
    vm."VENDASSESS" AS vendor_assessment,
    vm."contrState" AS contract_status,
    vm."dpa_state" AS dpa_status,
    CASE WHEN (c."gdprComp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial') OR c."CCPA_COMP" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial') OR c."PIPLcomp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial') OR c."loc_law_comp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial')) THEN true ELSE false END AS has_compliance_issue,
    CASE WHEN ac."critFindNum" > 0 OR ac."AudtrailState" IN ('Missing', 'Partial') OR ac."remed_state" != 'Completed' THEN true ELSE false END AS has_audit_issue
FROM "DataFlow" df
JOIN "DataProfile" dp ON df."RecordRegistry" = dp."Flow_Sign"
JOIN "AuditAndCompliance" ac ON dp."profileTrace" = ac.profjoin
JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON dp."riskJoin" = rm."RISKTRACE"
JOIN "Compliance" c ON rm."RISKTRACE" = c."risk_tie"
JOIN "VendorManagement" vm ON c."vendorTie" = vm."Vendor_Trace"
WHERE df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' <> df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country'

    c."gdprComp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial')

    OR c."PIPLcomp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial')
    OR c."loc_law_comp" IN ('Non-compliant', 'Partial')
    OR ac."critFindNum" > 0
    OR ac."AudtrailState" IN ('Missing', 'Partial')
    OR ac."remed_state" != 'Completed'
);
